products.name: OneTrust AI Governance
products.note: Privacy-first approach; strong data governance; compliance automation; good for privacy-primary orgs

profile_text.body:
OneTrust is an Atlanta, Georgia-based company founded in 2016 that describes itself as helping organizations manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk. Its site presents the company as a platform connecting privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in a single continuous system, with capabilities covering purpose definition, automated assessments, controls enforcement, and ongoing risk monitoring across domains.

The company's primary AI product is OneTrust AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. The site refers to this offering as the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform, and describes it as embedding governance into data and AI workflows to provide real-time visibility into how data and AI are used. The product profile notes a privacy-first approach with strengths in data governance and compliance automation, positioning it particularly for organizations where privacy is the primary concern.

The held facts record 54 law-related exposure entries tied to Georgia, the company's home state, though no specific litigation cases are listed in the data. OneTrust has a tracked presence on this site with a verified profile as of August 30, 2026, and no MCP server registrations on record.
